title: Harden CSV rerun pending publish manifests
summary: Backend pending-publish repair now normalizes legacy CSV rerun manifests that are missing current contract fields, then validates the repaired contract before exposing an apply candidate.
reason: A parked CSV rerun output was launch-blocking because its pending-publish manifest lacked pipeline_version and other current required fields. The live manifest needed a backend-authored repair, and the repair path needed regression coverage for this legacy shape.
behavior_before: Legacy CSV rerun pending-publish manifests could be parked with valid media evidence but fail the current pending_push_manifest.v1 contract, causing autonomy health to block new work with no safe repair candidate.
behavior_after: Repair dry-run recognizes legacy CSV rerun pending-publish manifests, fills deterministic current fields, maps legacy sidecar evidence, validates the full pending_push_manifest.v1 contract, and apply remains fingerprint-confirmed and manifest-only.
manual_validation: Live backend pending-publish recovery dry-run for E:\Videos\Scratch\State\PendingServerPush\The Crow (1994).manifest.json produced a safe-to-apply manifest-only candidate.

Live backend pending-publish repair apply wrote only the manifest, created backup E:\Videos\Scratch\State\RepairReconcileBackups\repair-reconcile-20260702T051858Z-c108fa9f\The Crow (1994).manifest.json, left source/output payloads unchanged, and returned post_diagnostic_status=ready.

Autonomy health gate rebuilt from E:\Videos\Scratch\State reported overall_status=review, blocked=false, can_start_new_work=true, blocked_count=0; the remaining review item was unrelated disk scan truncation.
rollback_plan: Revert the dry-run repair code and the two regression tests. If the live manifest repair must be reverted, restore E:\Videos\Scratch\State\PendingServerPush\The Crow (1994).manifest.json from the recorded RepairReconcileBackups copy; no media payload bytes were moved by this change.
notes:
Normalize legacy CSV rerun pending manifests into validated repair candidates.
Add confirmed apply regression proving legacy CSV rerun manifest repair is manifest-only.
Validation passed for focused repair-reconcile tests, pending-publish/API suites, PowerShell contract schema checks, and changed-file summary refresh.
